name: Gemma 4 E4B
short: Google DeepMind's April 2026 edge-optimized Gemma 4 variant — ~4B effective parameters via Per-Layer Embeddings (PLE) for on-device deployment, natively multimodal with 30-second audio input. MMLU-Pro 69.4%, MMMU-Pro 52.6%, and one of the lowest hallucination rates in the dataset (30.9%).
contextWindow: 128,000 total (half the 256K of the larger Gemma 4 variants)
modalities: Text, image, audio (max 30s) in; video as frames; text out; reasoning + function calling
